facts.text: A tall man in green shook every hand here Tuesday: “Well done, team.”
facts.why: Buddy's real line in the coffee shop is 'You did it! Congratulations! World's best cup of coffee! Great job, everybody! It's great to meet you!'
facts.fix: A tall man in green shook every hand here Tuesday: “Great job, everybody!”
